name: Ultimate X Bonus Streak
summary: Multi-hand video poker where a qualifying win starts a stream of multipliers on that line for the following hands. Streams abandoned by a previous player stay on screen.

facts.label: Feature bet
facts.value: 10 credits per hand (5 bet + 5 fee) turns the feature on

facts.label: Persistent state
facts.value: A qualifying win awards multipliers for the next 2 to 5 hands on that line

facts.label: Counting
facts.value: A line showing no multiplier counts as 1 in every total

facts.label: Edge
facts.value: The published rule says when play is favourable. Exact edge unknown.

wager.coinsNote: 10 credits per hand with the feature on

preserve.reason: Published returns are 97–99% without abandoned multipliers

return.reason: Below 99% on the published tables unless state qualifies

state.reason: Published entry thresholds for abandoned multipliers

rewards.reason: Double coin-in per hand — check total wager

practice.reason: No trainer for the multiplier strategy

state.fixedPrompt: Which machine is this? The rule only applies to the exact game, paytable and hand count.

inputs.label: Next hand — total of all multipliers
inputs.help: Add the first multiplier on every line. No multiplier counts as 1.

inputs.label: Next two hands — total
inputs.help: Next-hand total plus the total of the multipliers queued second.

inputs.label: Next three hands — total
inputs.help: Next-two total plus the total of the multipliers queued third.

state.noRuleText: No sourced entry rule for this configuration. Thresholds from another game, paytable or hand count are not reused.
